text.tspan: Per capita electricity generation vs. GDP per capita 2025
Average annual electricity generation per capita, measured in kilowatt-hours per person. Gross domestic
product (GDP) per capita is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
GDP per capita (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)

tspan.tspan: GDP data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Where data for 2025 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between
